question: Which of the following sentences correctly uses the idiom **"A picture is worth a thousand words"?**

options.text: I prefer reading detailed descriptions rather than looking at images, even though a picture is worth a thousand words.
The beautiful photograph captured the tragedy so well that no words were needed-truly, a picture is worth a thousand words.
Since she couldn't take a picture, she decided to write a long paragraph, as a picture is worth a thousand words.
He described the entire scene in detail because a picture is worth a thousand words.

solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 2.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The idiom **"A picture is worth a thousand words"** means that a single image can convey complex ideas or emotions more effectively than a lengthy description. (एक तस्वीर हजार शब्दों के बराबर होती है)

 
 
• **Example:** The old family photograph brought back memories that no words could describe – truly, a picture is worth a thousand words.
 
 
 
• The correct usage of this idiom is shown in Option 2, where the photograph effectively communicates emotions and meaning without the need for words.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 2**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Option 1:** "I prefer reading detailed descriptions rather than looking at images, even though a picture is worth a thousand words."

 
 
• **Explanation:** This sentence contradicts the meaning of the idiom by stating a preference for descriptions over images, which is opposite to the actual meaning. (यह वाक्य मुहावरे के अर्थ के विपरीत है।)
 
• **Example:** Incorrect usage of the idiom.
 
 
 
• **Option 3:** "Since she couldn’t take a picture, she decided to write a long paragraph, as a picture is worth a thousand words."
 
 
• **Explanation:** This implies that writing a long paragraph is equivalent to taking a picture, which is not the correct interpretation of the idiom. (यह वाक्य मुहावरे का सही उपयोग नहीं करता है।)
 
• **Example:** Incorrect usage of the idiom.
 
 
 
• **Option 4:** "He described the entire scene in detail because a picture is worth a thousand words."
 
 
• **Explanation:** This contradicts the idiom’s meaning, as it emphasizes detailed descriptions instead of relying on the power of a picture. (यह वाक्य मुहावरे के अर्थ के विपरीत है।)
 
• **Example:** Incorrect usage of the idiom.
